answer: Grades are sealed when submitted and only opened at close, so graders cannot react to or copy each other, which prevents a Sybil cluster from coordinating its votes within a single jury. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds.. The reason this works is that the attacker must pay a real cost on every identity, so scale becomes a liability rather than an advantage. Consider a mirror as the anchor of the cost.
